concerns.text: Root .gitignore was modified/created in PR #0 diff, which breaches operator boundary directives against editing root .gitignore to prevent parallel merge conflicts across branches.

Backup retention policy in scripts/backup.sh uses find -mtime +N, which relies on file modification times rather than backup timestamp filenames, making retention testing sensitive to touch timestamps.
PR #1 diff includes transient design draft mockups (design/draft/20261015125232-mockup/mockup.html and .png) which should be kept out of product code commits.
